summary:
I built and maintained the Summit crypto algo trading platform, an AI-driven SaaS application with a Telegram admin mini-app, backtest analysis, adaptive strategy layers, and live dashboard widgets. I also developed firmware for USB HID emulation on ESP32-S3 (j-uni-hid) and a Windows input filter driver (input-driver) for low-level event capture and injection.

On the Android side, I worked on j-tts-android, a multi-engine TTS app with custom accent and intonation control, and ozwil-android, an on-device LLM agent with sub-agent delegation and tool-use capabilities. I also refactored the intag2 file-tagging utility for Windows Explorer and improved its CI/CD pipeline for Microsoft Store publishing.

In parallel, I researched crypto price prediction models (crypto-model-research), iterating on ensemble architectures and forward-testing a champion with 77-90% win rate. I contributed new trading strategies to freqtrade_strategies, and maintained the jamminroot CV automation tool that generates dynamic PDFs and activity timelines from GitHub data.

items.title: Summit platform enhancements
items.description: Built the Telegram admin mini-app, added Named Analysis engine with backtest correlation, adaptive strategy gates and modifiers, risk dashboard widgets, and fixed various billing and UI issues.

items.title: Crypto price model research
items.description: Forward-tested a 13-feature champion model with 77-90% win rate, productionized ONNX ensemble export, and experimented with Split-MoE gate architectures.

items.title: CV automation tooling
items.description: Refined the CV generation pipeline: added skills section, rewrote role bullets from commit analysis, and improved heatmap and timeline rendering.

items.title: Lightweight AHK alternative
items.description: Built a minimal AutoHotKey alternative with interception support, scenario engine, typed actions, and a debug log.

items.title: Windows input filter driver
items.description: Developed a KMDF input filter driver with capture and injection, added push-style event delivery, integration-test runner, and per-event blocking support.

items.title: Android TTS with multiple engines
items.description: Added F5-TTS, GPT-SoVITS, and Piper engine scaffolds, implemented pitch control, RuNorm, and question/exclamation intonation sliders.

items.title: Aim-assist tooling
items.description: Refactored YOLO inference to DirectML, added bow/flick tracking with user-input compensation, and improved debug overlay.

items.title: Telegram content collector
items.description: Added ad filtering, webhook support, and ignored channels to the Telegram content collector.

items.title: USB HID firmware
items.description: Fixed USB disconnect issues and started drafting the v13 firmware variant with 8x8 matrix support.

items.title: File tagging for Windows Explorer
items.description: Preserved existing desktop.ini entries when writing folder metadata, fixed changelog generation, and added PDF support to context menu.

items.title: E-ink reader firmware
items.description: Added Map and Knowledge Base apps, optimized map renderer for Apple Silicon, and fixed FB2 encoding support.

items.title: Proxy client updates
items.description: Bumped Clash.Meta to re-expose proxy APIs and added XHTTP transport support via rebased mihomo fork.

items.title: On-device LLM agent
items.description: Rewrote sub-agent architecture with session-based delegation, added KV cache reuse, tool safety rails, and a setup wizard for model configuration.

items.title: Crypto price model experiments
items.description: Produced a champion Split-MoE ensemble, ran benchmark campaigns, and documented architecture and training pipeline.

items.title: Aim-assist tooling
items.description: Added linger mode, autofire, D3D11 overlay, and YOLO model integration; fixed status window and COM disconnect detection.

items.title: E-ink launcher
items.description: Built a note-taking-centric Android launcher for E-ink readers with backdrop overhaul, swipe navigation, and Onyx SDK integration.

items.title: Code intelligence engine
items.description: Added LSP integration, dead code detection, incremental sync, and expanded language support to C++, Go, Rust, and Svelte.

items.title: Telegram n8n node fork
items.description: Fixed auth race conditions, upgraded CI test version, added album trigger, and stabilized the publish workflow.

items.title: Neovim and dotfiles
items.description: Set up Neovim config with full IDE, fixed treesitter and LSP for 0.11 API, and added pre-commit hooks.

items.title: USB HID firmware evolution
items.description: Released v11 with BLE improvements, self-reporting, safe serial print, and reduced power consumption; fixed reconnection and touch jitter on Android.

items.title: Multi-bot Telegram monitoring
items.description: Built a web dashboard for monitoring multiple freqtrade bots, with daily profit calculations, bot token authentication, and Docker deployment.

items.title: Autonomous AI coding agent
items.description: Added squash-merging, worktree completion tracking, and Git rules system to the autonomous Claude coding agent.
